kind.value: Self-hosted scheduler, with a hosted cloud option

hosting.value: Self-host Lite, Pro or Enterprise, or use Mixpost Cloud

license.value: Lite: MIT (open source). Pro and Enterprise: source-available, one-time license

pricingModel.value: Self-hosted: one-time license per domain. Cloud: monthly plans

freeOption.value: Mixpost Lite is free to self-host (Facebook Pages, X and Mastodon only)

trial.value: Cloud: 7-day free trial; a card is required to start it. Pro and Enterprise: 14-day money-back guarantee

entryPaid.value: Pro, $299 one-time (1 year of updates). Cloud from $29/month

plans.value: Self-hosted: Lite free, Pro $299, Enterprise $1,199 (one-time). Cloud: Spark $29, Momentum $49 (24 channels), Business $79 (48), Agency $149 (180)

3.note: Cloud Spark (1 brand; channel limit not listed)

networks.value: Pro and Enterprise: 12, including Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Pixelfed and Google Business Profile. Cloud: 11, the same list without X. Lite: Facebook Pages, X and Mastodon

api.value: API and webhooks in Pro and Enterprise, and in Cloud Momentum and up

mcp.value: MCP server in Pro and Enterprise, and in Cloud Momentum and up

ai.value: AI Assistant in Pro and Cloud; Cloud plans include monthly AI credits

teams.value: Pro: unlimited users and workspaces. Cloud: 1 member on Spark and Momentum, 5 on Business, unlimited on Agency

selfHostStack.value: PHP 8.3+, MySQL, Redis and Nginx or Apache, installed with Docker or Composer
